rationale: Revised plan preserves all components needed to produce the portfolio deep-dive analysis (status distribution, denial rate, fraud prevalence, financial distributions, and monthly trends). The denial_rate denominator now excludes pending claims to compute the true adjudicated denial rate. The monthly_trend date_column now reflects service timing rather than adjudication lag.
changes_summary: Corrected denial_rate denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims and compute the true denial rate over only adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted). Corrected monthly_trend date_column from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to align the volume and spend trend with when services occurred rather than when claims were adjudicated.
